summary: Phase 1 contract for the sales-order ↔ manufacturing-order (SO↔MO) linkage, revised after critic review. Captures the cross-cutting business contract enforced by the manufacturing-order form, the bulk Create-MOs dialog on the SO detail page, and the routes/DAL functions that own creation, edit, sales-link validation, soft-delete blocks, and the one-time-claim invariant on salesOrderLineId. Documents the persisted enum vocabulary ('open'|'done' + cancelledAt/completedAt/actualQuantity/deletedAt columns), the post-948c155e behavior where sales-linked single-MO creation is allowed and seeds ingredients from the BOM, the per-endpoint idempotency asymmetry (an enumerated map across all MO and SO endpoints), and the operationally-observable replay behavior of confirmSalesOrder via beginInventoryOperationInTx. Splits the SO-line-rewrite risk surface into three distinct cases (same-itemId rewrite, different-itemId rewrite, rewrite while linked MO has pick allocations) and adds parallel bulk-create-from-SO serialization. Notes that confirmOversell and confirmShortage are accepted by the create-time payloads but unused by createSalesOrder / createManufacturingOrderInTx — there is no 400/409 shortage path on create. Distinguishes facts (cited to file:lines) from inferences (reasoned from cited code) from unknowns (deferred to later phases).

Also rejects when a linked MO carries an active stockAllocation pointing to a different SO line.

isSalesOrderMode is true exactly when !isEditing && salesOrderId is set && salesOrderLineId is null. In that mode the form fetches the preview and on submit POSTs to /api/sales-orders/:id/manufacturing-orders with the will_create line ids. When salesOrderLineId is also set (via handleSalesLineChange picking a specific line), the form is in single-create mode and POSTs to /api/manufacturing-orders with both ids in the payload. handleSalesLineChange forces productId, plannedQuantity, salesOrderId, salesOrderLineId, clears group remainder choices, and seeds ingredients from productMap.get(line.itemId).bom.

Ingredient dropdown options merge (a) ingredientItemOptions from getAvailableComponents (all non-master items minus the selected product) and (b) BOM rows + alternates. After 948c155e, this allows non-BOM ingredients to be picked when editing the seeded list.

Renders the SO-detail Create MOs dialog. Default selection is all 'will_create' lines; user can toggle, override per-line quantity, and resolve per-line group-remainder handling. Submits POST to /api/sales-orders/:id/manufacturing-orders. Default button label is 'Create MOs'.

Commit 948c155e removed the early-return that threw 'Create sales-linked manufacturing orders from the sales order Create MOs flow.' (400) when salesOrderId or salesOrderLineId was set. Direct sales-linked single-MO creation via POST /api/manufacturing-orders is now allowed.

Refuses soft-delete when status != 'open' OR completedAt is not null OR actualQuantity > 0 (6379-6391). Additional guards block when any batch is completed, any ingredient has actualQuantity > 0, or any inventory_event of type manufacturing_ingredient_consumption / manufacturing_output references the MO. Implication: in practice deletedAt is set only on cancelled OPEN MOs; a finalized (done) MO cannot be soft-deleted.

inferences.claim: An MO is conceptually 'cancelled' when deletedAt is non-null (cancelledAt is also set by cancelReleasedManufacturingOrderInTx, but the existing_active_mo claim filter keys on deletedAt). Conceptual 'completed' is status='open' (or 'done') with completedAt non-null and actualQuantity > 0; the persisted enum does not transition to a 'completed' literal.
Conceptual 'released' MO state is status='open' + deletedAt null + (a pickAllocation or non-pending batch has progressed). updateManufacturingOrder is blocked at exactly that transition.

Whether the idempotency asymmetry between MO POST/PUT/DELETE (no key) and SO POST/PUT/DELETE/confirm (key required) is INTENTIONAL is uncertain. The presence/absence of requireIdempotencyKey calls is directly observable in code (high confidence); the intent is not documented in any comment.

createSalesOrder reserves the full order against ATP via reserveForSalesInTx unconditionally. Since status is forced to 'open' on insert, every newly-created SO is in the reserving state — there is no 'draft non-reserving' SO at the persistence layer. confirmOversell is parsed by insertSalesOrderSchema but never consumed; there is no shortage-rejection path on create.
based_on: app/(dashboard)/sales/queries.ts:5911-6017 (no confirmOversell branch; reserveForSalesInTx called unconditionally at 5971-5984)

inferences.claim: createManufacturingOrderInTx ignores payload.confirmShortage. The flag is accepted by the schema for type-compatibility with downstream operations (release/pick), but the create path has no 'shortage detected → require confirmation' branch. Tests that expect a 400/409 shortage response from POST /api/manufacturing-orders will not see one.

Confirmation of an SO is functionally non-mutating at the SO state level (status stays 'open'), but it is NOT a pure no-op: the function writes/reads the inventory_operations idempotency table via beginInventoryOperationInTx/finishInventoryOperationInTx so retries with the same Idempotency-Key return the cached result without re-acquiring getLockedSalesOrderInTx.

The post-948c155e form requires a product that has at least one BOM ingredient before single sales-linked create can succeed; if a sales line's product has no active BOM, the new-MO form will accept the line but the API will reject the create with 'Products need a BOM before creating a manufacturing order' (400). The bulk SO-driven path filters such products earlier with the 'no_active_bom' skip reason.

unknowns: Exact join key used by moveReplacedSalesLineAllocationsInTx — itemId-match vs sortOrder-match vs both. Cited at call site but body not opened in Phase 0/1.
Whether `app_user` RLS lets the test fixture observe soft-deleted manufacturing/sales rows. Policies key on organizationId only, but full FORCE/policy text was not opened.

Body of activateManufacturingOrderInTx / addIngredientDemandForManufacturingInTx / cancelActiveStockAllocationsInTx / editExpectedFromManufacturingInTx — they are the side-effect helpers called from create/update; their exact ledger writes are out of scope for the linkage contract but matter for downstream tests.
Whether deleteManufacturingOrder (single) actually cascades through the same finalized-MO guard as deleteManufacturingOrdersInTx — call chain implies yes but not directly verified in Phase 0/1.

Whether the sales-order detail page hides Create MOs CTA only when hasManufacturableLines is false, or also when status='done' / deleted. CreateManufacturingOrdersDialog itself does not branch on order.status.

Whether beginInventoryOperationInTx is a no-op when idempotencyKey is null (the confirmSalesOrder code passes null when caller did not provide it). The replay-vs-first-call branching when no key is provided is not traced.

structured_output.purpose: Maintain a coherent link between an open sales order line and the manufacturing orders that fulfil it, so demand and supply stay traceable end-to-end across SO edits, bulk creation, single-line creation, completion, cancellation, and deletion. The linkage is a snapshot relationship (salesOrderId FK + salesOrderLineId uuid without FK + denormalized salesOrderNumber/salesCustomerName) that survives SO line rewrites and lets allocations migrate without breaking referential integrity.
structured_output.domain_role: Cross-cutting contract spanning sales (order CRUD + line rewrites + delete guard) and manufacturing (MO CRUD + bulk Create-MOs-from-SO + ingredient seeding from BOM). Also gates inventory item soft-delete (a referenced item cannot be removed while an open MO uses it as product or ingredient). Sits between the SO create-time reservation flow and the MO release/picking/completion flow, and is the source of the 'one MO per sales line' invariant.

PUT /api/manufacturing-orders/:id. Allowed only while status='open' and no pick/batch work has progressed. The sales link is re-validated with snapshot fallback so SO line rewrites do not orphan the MO.

user_actions.action: Edit an open SO with line changes (same items)
user_actions.effect: Hard-deletes and re-inserts all salesOrderLines. moveReplacedSalesLineAllocationsInTx migrates active allocations from old to new line ids when itemId matches. A linked MO's snapshot is preserved; on next MO edit/save, validateSalesLineLinkInTx re-binds salesOrderLineId via the snapshot-fallback lookup. updateSalesOrder does NOT inspect downstream MO pick state, so the SO update succeeds even when the linked MO already has pickAllocations (the snapshot rebind is deferred until the MO edit attempt, which is blocked by edit:work_started).

user_actions.action: Delete a sales order with a linked MO
user_actions.effect: Locks linked MOs, refuses with 'not to a matching active sales line' if any linked MO's salesOrderLineId is null or not in current line ids, or 'allocated to another sales order' if a shared allocation exists. risk_areas.area: salesOrderLineId one-time claim — cancellation reopens the claim
risk_areas.concern: Filter at lib/manufacturing/sales-order-manufacturability.ts:222-235 uses deletedAt IS NULL AND status IN ('open','done'). A cancelled (soft-deleted) MO does not block a new MO for that SO line. The completed case (status='open' or 'done', deletedAt null) is covered by an existing test (manufacturing-order.spec.ts:736-848); the cancelled→reopen case appears uncovered. Concurrent cancel + new create is also untested.

risk_areas.area: Same-itemId SO-line rewrite — snapshot fallback re-link succeeds
risk_areas.concern: When updateSalesOrder rewrites lines and the new line has the SAME itemId as the original, the next MO edit (which re-runs validateSalesLineLinkInTx with the existing snapshot) follows the fallback path (queries.ts:788-811) and re-binds salesOrderLineId to the new line id. Allocations migrate via moveReplacedSalesLineAllocationsInTx. This is the happy-path Phase-948c155e supports. Existing test covers it (manufacturing-order.spec.ts:850-907) for the typical case but does not cover concurrent rewrite + MO edit/release.

risk_areas.area: Different-itemId SO-line rewrite — snapshot drift blocks SO delete
risk_areas.concern: If the rewritten SO line has a DIFFERENT itemId, validateSalesLineLinkInTx's fallback finds no replacement (filters by salesOrderId + productId), the MO snapshot persists pointing at the now-deleted old line id, and any subsequent attempt to deleteSalesOrder hits deleteSalesLinkedManufacturingOrdersInTx's drift check (queries.ts:2367-2375) and is refused with 'manufacturing order {N} is linked to the order but not to a matching active sales line. Remove or repair the manufacturing link first.' Existing coverage is via manual db.update (sales-order.spec.ts:1297-1410), not via an actual line-rewrite. Cite app/(dashboard)/sales/queries.ts:6056-6241 (no MO-pick-state check on SO update) and app/(dashboard)/manufacturing/queries.ts:788-811 (productId-only fallback).

risk_areas.area: SO-line rewrite while linked MO has pickAllocations or non-pending batches
risk_areas.concern: updateSalesOrder does NOT inspect downstream MO pick state — the SO update succeeds even when the linked MO has pickAllocations or active batches. The MO's salesOrderLineId snapshot continues to point at the deleted old line id until the next MO edit attempt, which is blocked by edit:work_started (queries.ts:3877-3882). The MO therefore stays linked at the snapshot level but cannot rebind via validateSalesLineLinkInTx (which only runs on MO edit). Net effect: a stale snapshot persists invisibly; SO delete is blocked by drift detection until the MO is finalized or cancelled. This is the 948c155e regression class. Cite app/(dashboard)/sales/queries.ts:6056-6241 (no pickAllocations check on SO update) and app/(dashboard)/manufacturing/queries.ts:3877-3882 (MO edit guard).

After 948c155e, POST /api/manufacturing-orders with both ids set goes through prepareCreateIngredientsInTx, which expects the submitted ingredient row count to match the current BOM row count exactly. The form seeds ingredients from productMap at form-load time and does NOT subscribe to BOM revisions. If the BOM is edited (component added/removed) between form load and submit, the create returns 409 bom_changed and the user must reload. This is a regression surface specific to the new pathway.

Unlike POST /api/sales-orders, the MO POST does not require an Idempotency-Key and does not replay through beginInventoryOperationInTx. Client retries can create duplicate MOs that each take a salesOrderLineId one-time-claim — the second insert succeeds because the first's existing_active_mo only blocks the SUBSEQUENT Create-MOs flow, not parallel single-create posts. The same gap applies to PUT and DELETE on /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]. Whether the gap is intentional is undocumented; see BR-9.

risk_areas.area: Item soft-delete only blocks status='open' MOs
risk_areas.concern: deleteItem / deleteItems both filter status='open'. A 'done' MO (status='done' OR a completed open MO via completedAt) does not block deletion. The CLAUDE.md description 'Items used by draft or released MOs' translates to the open-status guard only — completed MOs do not protect their referenced items. Item delete is gated by module:inventory write at the route layer (app/api/items/route.ts:27,40 and app/api/items/[id]/route.ts:18,94); a user without that role cannot exercise this path at all.

test/e2e/slow/manufacturing-order.spec.ts:462-475 ('blocks direct sales-linked creation') still asserts the old 400 'Create sales-linked manufacturing orders' guard removed by 948c155e. risk_areas.concern: CLAUDE.md narrates 'draft|released|completed|cancelled' for MOs and 'draft|confirmed|partially_shipped' for SOs, but the schema and DAL operate on 'open'|'done' plus the dated columns. Test assertions must use the persisted enum literals; downstream phases should not assert status='cancelled' or status='completed' literals.

risk_areas.area: Confirm endpoint behavior is replay-stub, not state-mutating
risk_areas.concern: confirmSalesOrder runs beginInventoryOperationInTx + finishInventoryOperationInTx but never mutates SO fields. risk_areas.area: Lock-order asymmetry between SO rewrite and MO operations
risk_areas.concern: validateSalesLineLinkInTx does NOT FOR UPDATE the sales-order line. createManufacturingOrdersFromSalesOrderInTx FOR UPDATEs only the salesOrders row (queries.ts:3674). updateSalesOrder hard-deletes lines without locking dependent manufacturingOrders. Posting twice to /api/sales-orders/[id]/confirm with the same Idempotency-Key replays through beginInventoryOperationInTx (sales/queries.ts:7563-7591) and returns the cached {id} on the second call without re-running getLockedSalesOrderInTx. Risk surface: (a) a stale Idempotency-Key could be silently swallowed and the caller never observes that the SO was already 'confirmed'; (b) if the first call partial-failed before finishInventoryOperationInTx wrote the result, the second call's replay state is implementation-defined. Tests should assert (i) both responses are 200, (ii) exactly one inventory_operations row exists for the operationName+key pair, and (iii) the SO status remains 'open' across both calls. Different Idempotency-Keys must each produce their own inventory_operations row.

risk_areas.area: Parallel bulk Create-MOs-from-SO submissions — row-lock serialization
risk_areas.concern: createManufacturingOrdersFromSalesOrderInTx acquires FOR UPDATE on the salesOrders row at lib/../manufacturing/queries.ts:3663-3674, so concurrent POSTs to /api/sales-orders/[id]/manufacturing-orders against the same SO serialize at that lock. The second caller sees the recomputed summary with existing_active_mo for any line the first caller claimed, and either returns {created:[], skipped:[...existing_active_mo]} silently or returns 409 'Selected manufacturing orders changed. Refresh and try again.' (queries.ts:3720-3730) depending on whether its original payload still includes those lines. No FOR UPDATE is acquired on salesOrderLines or on items, so a parallel /api/manufacturing-orders single-create POST against a different SO line can interleave inside the bulk path. Not directly tested.
